description: Per-board estimates for run.py's memory gate and its order (tier_estimates.py --refresh writes this file from run.py logs; README.md, 'How to measure'). Per board: pads and copper layers, and per kind (layout: the sweep and the quick tier; short, schematic, designer, expansion: those tiers) peak_rss_mb (the largest measured peak of the rows times margin), measured_mb, seconds (the largest) and the rows ([source, peak MB, seconds]) of the newest `window` sources that measured the board; sources: each log's kind and time. model: per family (layout, route) the size model over pads x layers for boards without a row (fit to the largest measured peaks, raised to the quantile; times margin).
